release.yml::release: push trigger is tags-only (v*): the macOS/Windows installers build only when a release tag is pushed (or by manual dispatch), never per commit
egress-helper.yml::macos: push trigger is tags-only (egress-v*): the helper's macOS build runs only when its release tag is pushed
egress-helper.yml::windows: push trigger is tags-only (egress-v*): the helper's Windows build runs only when its release tag is pushed
